description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter called ProductLoadStateAdapter that manages load states (loading, error) for paginated data in an Android app. It contains a nested ViewHolder class to bind load state changes to a footer UI layout, enabling retry functionality on errors.

classes.name: ProductLoadStateAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter extending LoadStateAdapter to handle load states with a retry mechanism.

classes.name: LoadStateViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for binding load state UI elements and handling user interactions in the footer view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the load state to UI elements, showing loading indicator or error message and handling retry clicks.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a LoadStateViewHolder by inflating the item load state footer layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the load state to the specified ViewHolder.
